```python
import requests

api_key = "my_api"
domain = "example.org"
limit = 10
cursor = "abc"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/subdomains"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}
params = {
    "limit": limit,
    "continuation_cursor": cursor,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
data = response.json()

# Extract only the IDs and context attributes
related_objects = [
    {
        "id": obj["id"],
        "context_attributes": obj.get("context_attributes")
    }
    for obj in data.get("data", [])
]

print(related_objects)
```

This script will print a list of dictionaries containing each subdomain’s ID and its context attributes, limited to 10 results starting from the cursor `"abc"`.
